specs.source_title: Introduction to Bambu Lab Build Plates | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: Build Plate Types › Engineering Plate tab › paragraph 1
specs.quote: The Engineering Plate is manufactured using a corrosion-resistant reinforced coating process, specifically optimized for printing engineering materials such as ABS, ASA, PC, and PA.
specs.note: The manufacturing process the wiki states in the tab's descriptive paragraph; a value read from prose stays unverified (§C.6). The store page names the materials in its own row ("Polyester powder + manganese steel"), written below as part.material.

specs.source_title: Introduction to Bambu Lab Build Plates | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: Build Plate Types › Engineering Plate tab › Features › Smooth and Natural Surface Finish
specs.quote: The smooth base coating of the Engineering Plate provides printed models with a flat and refined bottom surface, allowing the bottom layer to blend seamlessly with the rest of the model.
specs.note: The wiki calls it a "smooth base coating" (and, under "Durable and Smooth Coating", "Its smooth finish"); the store page says the same ("Smooth & Natural Surface Finish: The smooth base coating can impart a smooth & flat texture to the bottom surface of the printed object"). Read from prose, so unverified (§C.6).

notes: Option groups: Printer Model (A2L, X2D, P2S, H2C, H2S, H2D, A1, P1 Series, X1C) and Option (Engineering Plate, Engineering Plate + Glues). The "+ Glues" variants say "Includes Glue Stick (1 pc) and Liquid Glue (1 pc)" (the page's variant.note rows); that is the bundle's make-up, not a packing list, so in_the_box stays empty (a list of the two glues would omit the plate) and package.contents is not_published; the bundle's make-up is recorded as two "includes" relations scoped to the "Engineering Plate + Glues" option.

Sizes per printer come from the plates wiki's general "Build Plate Dimensions" table and agree with the store's "Usable Print Size" row (X1C/P1P/P1S/A1/P2S/X2D - 256*256mm, H2D/H2S - 350*320mm, H2C/A2L - 330*320mm). The store row is also written per Printer Model value as printing.usable_print_size (verified table segments).

Packaging: the store's "Packaging Size" and "Packaging Weight" cells label each segment by printer model, so each value is scoped to the plate-only variant of each named model. The H2C/A2L plate (330*320 mm) ships in the same 393*380*15 mm, 0.78 kg package as the H2D/H2S plate, as published. No value is given for the "+ Glues" bundle variants. No CBM is derived. Weights are written as published (0.50 kg, 0.78 kg); the runner stores grams.

Thickness (0.5mm) and material ("Polyester powder + manganese steel") are verified store-page rows that no other source contradicts; the curated file repeats them with the page's quotes (same values and rank, so the merge keeps the page rows unchanged).

Glue type nuance: the material-table wiki's general glue table marks liquid glue "Not Compatible" for PET-CF/GF and "Not Recommended" for PC and PA / PA-CF/GF / PAHT-CF/GF, while the store's Engineering Plate table says "Glue Stick/Liquid Glue" for those rows. Kept as notes; no spec key carries glue type.

Bed temperatures per filament on this plate (wiki 30-120 ℃ by material; store 35~110℃) have no plate-type registry key (print_settings.bed_temp is filament-only); they stay in the quotes and notes of the material relations. Where the store and the wiki differ (PLA, PVA, TPU, PC, PA, PET-CF) the relation note says so.

Plates wiki Important Notice (two generations, QR recognition) names the Textured PEI, Smooth PEI and Cool Plate SuperTack plates only, not the Engineering Plate; no generation-specific relation is written. The Engineering Plate FAQ ("Build Plate Recognition Failure": clean QR code, update firmware, or disable recognition) and store Consideration 8 (latest firmware: Micro Lidar calibration fully compatible) are guidance, not specs.
Wipe zone wear on X1, P1 and A1 printers (store Consideration 4, plates wiki Appendix) is described as normal; prose only.
Warranty and consumable sentences (store Consideration 9) are already withheld by the deterministic layer as owner-only manufacturer_terms; nothing is added here.

part.surface_treatment and part.surface_type are read from the wiki's descriptive paragraphs, so they stay unverified (§C.6: a value from prose stays unverified); part.type comes from the wiki's list of build plate types.

Store Consideration 6 ("Bambu Lab recommends only using Bambu Lab official glue on the Bambu Lab build plates") names no product and sits in a liability sentence; no recommended_with relation is written. The glue requirement is the requires relation.
Printer compatibility targets follow compat-targets.json: A2L, X2D, H2C, H2S are printer handles; P2S, H2D, A1, P1 Series and X1C are families (no single handle).
